title: As above, so below
sub: One take that ends where it begins. Out from a single bead of Lyra's DNA — glass, here, with a world inside it — through her cell, her eye and her, lying in the flowers beside Seven Havens' temple, past the Earth, the Sun, the Milky Way and the cosmic web to the edge of the observable universe; and on past it, to find our universe a marble over the palm of one of its keepers, strung with others on a thread of light as DNA is wound on its spools; then out of their world, whose sky is the inside of the bead it began on. It plays round and round.

title: Trailer
sub: Universe in twenty-five seconds, cut from the journey: up from the flowers beside Seven Havens' temple, past the Earth and the Milky Way into the cosmic web, then back down into Lyra's eye, through her iris, to the DNA in one of her cells.

title: The journey
sub: From Lyra lying in the flowers beside the temple in Seven Havens' gardens out past the Earth, the Sun and the Milky Way to the edge of the observable universe, all the way back down into her eye, through its iris and the cornea's living cells into one of them, to the DNA wound on its nucleosomes, and out again: thirty-five powers of ten in one take.
